system.description: The master of Ephemeral Binding turns an otherwise mundane object or person into a fetter. The Necromancer coats the subject with a Blood Trait's worth of vitae (a person must ingest it), spends a Willpower Trait, and makes a Social Challenge against the targeted wraith (one already seen or known). Success makes the subject a fetter to that wraith for the remainder of the game session; a further Willpower Trait at the start of each new session keeps it active, or a permanent Willpower Trait extends the effect to a full year of play. A botch alerts the wraith to the attempt.
system.source: Clanbook: Giovanni, Chapter Two: It Runs in the Family
